cmd.name: foraging
cmd.description: Restores the food of all units by 2 (3 for the caster's).\nIt has a 1 minute cooldown

cmd.name: wisdom
cmd.description: Increases the level of all units by 1 and the experience by another 5 for the caster's (up to level 25).\nIt takes 20 seconds

cmd.name: exhaust
cmd.description: Every 5 seconds reduces the stamina of all units by 10 (5 for the caster's).\nIt lasts 30 seconds

cmd.name: soothing
cmd.description: Every 5 seconds restores the stamina of all units by 5 (10 for the caster's).\nIt lasts 30 seconds

cmd.name: sacrifice
cmd.description: Every 4 seconds deals 40 damage to all sages (20 for the caster's).\nIt lasts 1 minute

cmd.name: gold_rain
cmd.description: Every 3 seconds adds 10 gold to all settlements (15 for the caster's).\nIt lasts 2 minutes

cmd.name: plague
cmd.description: Poisons 1 in every 7 units (8 for the caster's).\nIt has a 1 minute cooldown

cmd.name: bloodlust
cmd.description: Allows all warriors to ignore enemy armor and the caster's melee units present at the time of the activation gain 6 bonus damage for the duration.\nIt lasts 30 seconds

cmd.name: starvation
cmd.description: Every 5 seconds reduces the food of all settlements and caravans by 3% and 30 (2% and 20 for the caster's).\nIt lasts 2 minutes

cmd.name: earthquake
cmd.description: Every second deals 300 damage to all strongholds, outposts and shipyards (225 to the caster's).\nIt lasts 10 seconds

cmd.name: uprising
cmd.description: Makes all outposts neutral and reduces the populations of all villages by 20 (10 for the caster's).\nIt takes 2 minutes

cmd.name: teuton_horde
cmd.description: Gathers a level 12 (18 for the caster) horde of 100 Teutons (40 riders, 40 archers and 20 raiders) in all strongholds, depleting their population, and gathers 2000 food in all Teuton tents (4000 for the caster's).\nIt takes 3 minutes
